channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: World News Today Live Updates on August 18, 2026 : Iran to shift to ‘fully offensive’ posture as US peace talks stall: Report
item.description: World News Today Live Updates on August 18, 2026: Stay informed on global events with our in-depth world news coverage, bringing you the latest developments across politics, economy, and culture. Discover insights into international affairs, breaking news, and the trends shaping our interconnected world, all in one place.

item.title: Iran to shift to ‘fully offensive’ posture as US peace talks stall: Report
item.description: The two sides had been expected to reach a final peace agreement by Monday under a memorandum of understanding signed in June.

item.title: Netanyahu-Kushner meet: US General to monitor Hamas disarmament as Israel rejects Gaza exit before weapons handover
item.description: The meeting came a day after Kushner held rare direct talks with Hamas leader Khalil al-Hayya in Egypt as Washington pushes to revive a 15-point roadmap for ending the Gaza war.

item.title: Quote of the Day by Lucy van Pelt: ‘The world is full of people who are willing to give you advice, but…’
item.description: A familiar line from Lucy van Pelt captures a simple truth about advice, responsibility and the difference between having an opinion and bearing the consequences.

item.title: UK PM Andy Burnham exchanged messages with Susie Wiles impersonator before suspecting contact was fake: Report
item.description: The incident reportedly prompted concern within the British government and was raised with the White House by the British embassy in Washington.

item.title: Quote for the day by Albert Camus: ‘Life is meaningless, but worth living, provided…’
item.description: Albert Camus quote means that by accepting that life doesn't lead to a grand, eternal conclusion, you are free to fully appreciate the journey itself.

item.title: ‘An ordinary BJP karyakarta’: Smriti Irani joins BJP's national team as general secretary; thanks PM Modi, Nitin Nabin
item.description: Smriti Irani has been appointed BJP national general secretary, with the former Union minister thanking PM Modi and party chief Nitin Nabin.

item.title: India leases 2 MQ-9B Sea Guardian drones for Navy from US at ₹1,943 crore for 30 months
item.description: The Navy already operates two Sea Guardian drones, which were leased a few years ago. The MQ-9B Sea Guardian remotely-piloted aircraft are equipped with advanced systems, state-of-the-art sensors and sophisticated payloads.

item.title: In four months, UP judge hands down 22 death sentences in 10 cases: Who is Ravi Kumar Diwakar?
item.description: UP judge Ravi Kumar Diwakar has sentenced 22 people to death in 10 cases over four months in Muzaffarnagar. The verdicts include murder, kidnapping and robbery cases. Diwakar earlier drew national attention for ordering the 2022 Gyanvapi survey.

item.title: Jharkhand JSSC-CGL exam cancelled: CM Hemant Soren accepts students’ demands
item.description: Jharkhand CM Hemant Soren announces JSSC-CGL exam cancellation and inquiry into recruitment exams conducted since 2014.

item.title: Trump’s $100,000 H-1B fee row: Indian-American Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi warns US could lose top tech talent
item.description: Speaking during an episode of the Spill the Tea interview series, the Illinois Democrat said businesses would ultimately have to choose between bringing talent into the US and shifting jobs abroad.

item.title: 'What do they get back?': Shehzad Poonawalla calls to scrap income tax for salaried middle class
item.description: BJP leader Shehzad Poonawalla called for scrapping personal income tax for the salaried middle class, citing poor public services including bad roads, air pollution, toxic water and corruption. He also announced his resignation from the BJP, citing personal and financial reasons.

item.title: Indian-origin teen became world's youngest CA at 16, now works as research analyst
item.description: Lakshmanan Meyyappan's interest in finance developed during the Covid-19 pandemic, shortly after he completed his Class 10 board examinations. He began preparing for the Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA) qualification at the age of 15

item.title: US Navy destroyer hit by 4-day power failure in South China Sea amid Iran war strain: Report
item.description: The Benfold's power failure adds another equipment-related setback as US warships face demanding operational schedules across multiple regions.

item.title: Piyush Goyal appointed BJP national treasurer in major organizational overhaul
item.description: The senior cabinet minister returns as national treasurer in a major BJP reshuffle, retaining his commerce portfolio as the party announces a fresh team of office-bearers.

item.title: Senior IAS officer Anurag Jain takes over as NITI Aayog CEO
item.description: Former Madhya Pradesh chief secretary Anurag Jain is the new CEO of NITI Aayog, succeeding B.V.R. Subrahmanyam. His appointment, approved for a two-year term, aims to bolster cooperation between the Centre and states while advancing government policies.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere’s ‘gut-wrenching’ reality — Postpartum depression, addiction & handing over custody of daughter Kaya
item.description: Hayden Panettiere was diagnosed with postpartum depression when Kaya was 4 months old and was prescribed medication to help her cope.

item.title: Jared Kushner meets Netanyahu after Hamas talks: What are his Middle East business links?
item.description: Trump's Middle East envoy Jared Kushner met Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu after talks with Hamas on reviving Gaza peace efforts. Kushner's Middle East ties also extend to business, with his Affinity Partners' Phoenix investment delivering a 9X return, Forbes reported.

item.title: US vs China AI race: Washington plans to tell countries to choose between Pax Silica and Beijing’s rival AI framework
item.description: A US official and an internal State Department draft reviewed by Reuters said Washington is preparing to send the message to countries that have signed a US-backed statement on AI cooperation.

item.title: Ferrari’s first fully electric car sells for ₹382 crore, breaks Daytona SP3 record
item.description: Ferrari shares gained as much as 1.4% in Milan on Monday. The stock had risen 13% so far this year through Friday, helped by demand for high-priced models including the $3.6 million F80 hybrid.

item.title: Potholed roads, traffic snarls, industry exit threat: Maharashtra to fix infrastructure gaps at Pune’s Chakan belt
item.description: Amid complaints from companies, the Maharashtra government has acknowledged serious infrastructure issues in Chakan, prompting the formation of a panel. CM Fadnavis promised relief.

item.title: US commander acknowledges mental health concerns aboard USS Abraham Lincoln: ‘All is not perfect’
item.description: US Central Command chief Admiral Brad Cooper made the comments after visiting the USS Abraham Lincoln, which has been deployed for more than eight months.

item.title: No signs of ‘foul play’ in Hayden Panettiere’s death, say Greenville Police
item.description: Hayden Panettiere, 36, was found dead at an apartment complex in South Carolina on Sunday, August 16. Panettiere's father, Skip, announced the actor's death

item.title: Who is Deepak Mhaskey, ex-Chemistry professor replacing Amit Malviya as BJP social media chief?
item.description: Deepak Mhaskey, a former Chemistry professor from Chhattisgarh, has replaced Amit Malviya as the BJP's national social media convenor. A first-generation BJP leader, Mhaskey has 15 years of experience in the party's IT and social media operations.

item.title: Senior engineer laid off by Adobe becomes driver: 'Glad I’ll be driving bus instead of computer'
item.description: James Strawn, who lives in Colorado, said he is now preparing to begin work as a school bus driver after being unable to secure another job in the technology industry.

item.title: Gulf war widens? Trump threatens to bomb Oman if it ‘gets in the way’ of Iran deal
item.description: The US-Iran war has dragged on for nearly six months with no resolution in sight. Peace talks have stalled, and intermittent clashes keep flaring up, disrupting the flow of oil and other key commodities through the crucial Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Faced a bribe demand? Indian student creates website 'bribe.fyi' where you can report it anonymously
item.description: The departments currently listed include the Police, RTO, Revenue/Land Records, Passport Office, Municipal Corporation, GST Office, Electricity Board, Income Tax, and Food and Drug Administration.

item.title: ‘Iran cannot have…’: Trump reiterates ‘number one goal’ for US; oil rises as war talks stall
item.description: The renewed warning came as Iran signalled that it had yet to decide whether to resume negotiations with the US.

item.title: Amit Malviya dropped as BJP IT cell chief; Deepak Mhaskey named successor in major reshuffle
item.description: The BJP has replaced longtime IT cell chief Amit Malviya with Chhattisgarh's Deepak Mhaskey in a major organisational reshuffle. The party also appointed four new social media coordinators, while Anil Baluni will continue as Media Convenor.

item.title: Indian Embassy to host open house in Abu Dhabi for Indians — Check date, time & core objective
item.description: The Open House session for the Indian community will be held from 2 PM to 4 PM on Friday, August 21, at the Embassy of India in Abu Dhabi.

item.title: Mint Explainer: How India is connecting its border and coastal frontiers
item.description: India plans to build over 5,000 km of highways along its land and maritime frontiers over the next three to five years, with potential investment exceeding ₹2 trillion.

item.title: Inside Trump's Iran backchannel: How Iraq's Barzani helped the US prez reach IRGC
item.description: The Trump administration secretly reached out to Iran’s powerful IRGC through Iraq's Kurdistan Region President Nechirvan Barzani after US officials doubted whether Iran’s negotiators had authority to seal a deal.

item.title: Fire breaks out in basement of Mumbai's Income Tax office ‘Aayakar Bhavan’
item.description: The Mumbai Fire Brigade received the initial call at 2:01 pm. The blaze was officially declared a Level-I fire at 2:10 p.m.

item.title: Quote of the day by Thomas Henry Huxley: 'The deepest sin against the human mind is to believe things without…'
item.description: These words of Thomas Henry Huxley are about reason, scepticism and intellectual honesty, urging people to demand evidence before belief. Here's why it works as a rule for thinking clearly.

item.title: Iran planning Gulf war escalation? Tehran took 'full advantage of US ceasefire' to boost missiles, drones: Report
item.description: Iran's hard-line leadership used the lull created by a US-Iran MoU to strengthen its military, accelerating missile and drone production, expanding regional coordination and tightening IRGC control as it prepared for a potentially wider conflict.
